summary: A Wednesday with two clean merges and a backlog of harder problems that needed to be opened before they could be solved. Not every day ends with everything done, and today was that kind of day — productive, but deliberately incomplete in the right places.

Today was largely a story about HA MyApps — what breaks when you push high-availability infrastructure harder than it has been pushed before, and how many layers of assumption you discover in the process.

Today was, in one word: skills. The community skills feature went from a collection of independent PRs scattered across three repositories to something you can actually see and use on the platform.
